description: Figure 4 is a line plot titled "TruthfulQA" that illustrates the relationship between the number of demonstrations and the MC1 score for different models. The horizontal axis, labeled "#Demonstrations," is scaled linearly from 0 to 2000, with tick marks at intervals of 500. The vertical axis, labeled "MC1," is scaled linearly from 37 to 39, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot displays three lines: "Linear SAE" is represented by a solid black line with black circular markers; "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" is shown as a dashed pink line with pink circular markers; and "ICD" is a dashed cyan line with cyan circular markers. The "Linear SAE" line begins at a score of approximately 37.2 at 0 demonstrations and shows a steady increase, reaching a score of about 39.2 at 2000 demonstrations. The "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" line starts at a score of 37.1 and remains relatively flat, ending at approximately 37.5. The "ICD" line begins at a score of 38.0 and remains constant at this level throughout the range of demonstrations.
